name: Luoyang Shenglong
summary: Luoyang Shenglong Mining Group Co., Ltd., based in Luoyang, China, is primarily involved in the production, refinement, and distribution of molybdenum-centric goods. Their product line features ferromolybdenum, various molybdenum concentrates, molybdenum oxides, and also copper concentrates. The firm began its operations on December 8, 2020.
